title: An organization server's receipt for an adaptation plan (DEC-0138)
description: What the server answers to an accepted or repeated org-adaptation/1, and to a GET of the plan: the revision it holds, that revision's digest, and each request's decision, bound to the request's digest. docs/specification/membership.md#the-adaptation-plan.

digest.description: adaptationDigest of the plan held: SHA-256 over its RFC 8785 form.
requestDigest of the request the decision is bound to.

state.description: pending: waiting for a decision; granted or refused: an administrator's decision; expired: the server closed the request, undecided after a time it sets or a decision that lapsed. Bound to the request's digest: a changed request is pending again.

at.description: When an administrator decided, or when the server closed the request or the decision lapsed (expired); absent while pending.
